title: Serotonin syndrome
whatItIs: Too much serotonin in the body. It most often starts within hours of adding a medicine or raising a dose, and it ranges from mild to life-threatening.

emergency.title: Get emergency help right away
emergency.body: High fever, stiff muscles, a seizure or confusion after taking something new.

items.name: MAOI antidepressants
items.examples: Phenelzine (Nardil), tranylcypromine (Parnate), selegiline. Needs a washout of about two weeks.

items.name: Linezolid and methylene blue
items.examples: An antibiotic (Zyvox) and a dye used in hospitals.

items.name: St. John's wort
items.examples: Herbal supplement for mood or sleep.

items.name: 5-HTP and tryptophan
items.examples: Supplements sold for mood and sleep.

items.name: Cough medicine with DXM
items.examples: Look for "DM" or dextromethorphan on the label, as in Robitussin DM or Delsym.
